name: add_forecast_from_work_efforts
script:
# Флаг для включения/отключения детального логирования
ENABLE_DETAILED_LOG = True

def debug_log(message):
    """Логирует сообщение только если детальное логирование включено"""
    if ENABLE_DETAILED_LOG:
        log(message)

log("_________________ Add Forecast From Work Efforts _________________")

project = frappe.form_dict.get('project')
selected_tasks_raw = frappe.form_dict.get('tasks')
forecast_details_raw = frappe.form_dict.get('forecast_details')
confirm_recalc = frappe.form_dict.get('confirm_recalc', False)

# Преобразуем confirm_recalc в булево значение
if confirm_recalc in ['True', 'true', 1, '1', True]:
    confirm_recalc = True
else:
    confirm_recalc = False

debug_log(f"  confirm_recalc: {confirm_recalc}")
debug_log("STEP 1: Parameters received")
debug_log(f"  project: {project}")

# Парсим JSON
if selected_tasks_raw:
    selected_tasks = json.loads(selected_tasks_raw)
    debug_log(f"  selected_tasks parsed: {len(selected_tasks)} tasks")
else:
    selected_tasks = []

if forecast_details_raw:
    forecast_details = json.loads(forecast_details_raw)
    debug_log(f"  forecast_details parsed: {len(forecast_details)} tasks")
else:
    forecast_details = {}

# Проверки на валидность
if not project:
    log("ERROR: No project specified")
    frappe.response["message"] = {
        'success': False,
        'error': 'No project specified'
    }
elif not selected_tasks:
    log("ERROR: No tasks selected")
    frappe.response["message"] = {
        'success': False,
        'error': 'No tasks selected'
    }
else:
    debug_log("STEP 2: Getting project data")
    
    # ========== 1. ПОЛУЧАЕМ ДАННЫЕ ПРОЕКТА ==========
    Project = frappe.qb.DocType('Project')
    project_query = (
        frappe.qb.from_(Project)
        .select(Project.custom_payment_scheme)
        .where(Project.name == project)
        .limit(1)
    )
    project_result = project_query.run(as_dict=True)
    payment_scheme = project_result[0].get('custom_payment_scheme') if project_result else None
    debug_log(f"  payment_scheme: {payment_scheme}")
    
    # ========== 2. ПОЛУЧАЕМ СТАТЬИ БЮДЖЕТА ==========
    debug_log("STEP 2.1: Getting account table from project")
    
    AccountTable = frappe.qb.DocType('Account Table')
    account_query = (
        frappe.qb.from_(AccountTable)
        .select(
            AccountTable.ac_valid_from,
            AccountTable.ac_type,
            AccountTable.ac_account
        )
        .where(AccountTable.parent == project)
    )
    account_table = account_query.run(as_dict=True)
    
    debug_log(f"  account_table found: {len(account_table)}")
    
    # Сортируем статьи по дате начала действия
    account_table.sort(key=lambda x: x.get('ac_valid_from') if x.get('ac_valid_from') else frappe.utils.getdate("1900-01-01"))
    
    # ========== 3. ПОЛУЧАЕМ PROJECT TEAM DETAILS ==========
    debug_log("STEP 3: Getting team details")
    
    ProjectTeamDetails = frappe.qb.DocType('Project Team Details')
    team_query = (
        frappe.qb.from_(ProjectTeamDetails)
        .select(
            ProjectTeamDetails.pt_role,
            ProjectTeamDetails.pt_participant,
            ProjectTeamDetails.pt_cost_level,
            ProjectTeamDetails.pt_category
        )
        .where(ProjectTeamDetails.parent == project)
        .where(ProjectTeamDetails.virtual_worker == 0)
    )
    team_details = team_query.run(as_dict=True)
    
    team_details_map = {}
    for td in team_details:
        key = (td.get('pt_role'), td.get('pt_participant'))
        team_details_map[key] = td
    
    debug_log(f"  team_details found: {len(team_details)}")
    
    # ========== 3.1. ПОЛУЧАЕМ ВИРТУАЛЬНЫХ УЧАСТНИКОВ ==========
    debug_log("STEP 3.1: Getting virtual team details")
    
    virtual_query = (
        frappe.qb.from_(ProjectTeamDetails)
        .select(
            ProjectTeamDetails.pt_role,
            ProjectTeamDetails.pt_cost_level,
            ProjectTeamDetails.pt_category,
            ProjectTeamDetails.virtual_worker,
            ProjectTeamDetails.worker_type
        )
        .where(ProjectTeamDetails.parent == project)
        .where(ProjectTeamDetails.virtual_worker == 1)
    )
    virtual_team_details = virtual_query.run(as_dict=True)
    
    virtual_team_map = {}
    for vtd in virtual_team_details:
        virtual_team_map[vtd.get('pt_role')] = vtd
        debug_log(f"  Virtual worker for role {vtd.get('pt_role')}: cost_level={vtd.get('pt_cost_level')}, category={vtd.get('pt_category')}")
    
    # ========== 4. ОПРЕДЕЛЯЕМ ТИП ПОЛЬЗОВАТЕЛЯ ==========
    debug_log("STEP 4: Getting worker types")
    
    user_type_cache = {}
    Worker = frappe.qb.DocType('Worker')
    
    for td in team_details:
        user = td.get('pt_participant')
        if user and user not in user_type_cache:
            worker_query = (
                frappe.qb.from_(Worker)
                .select(Worker.wtype)
                .where(Worker.wuser == user)
                .limit(1)
            )
            worker_result = worker_query.run(as_dict=True)
            
            if worker_result and worker_result[0].get('wtype'):
                user_type_cache[user] = worker_result[0].get('wtype')
                debug_log(f"  User {user} -> {user_type_cache[user]}")
            else:
                # Если у Worker нет типа - это ошибка данных, пропускаем
                debug_log(f"  WARNING: User {user} has no Worker type, will be skipped")
                user_type_cache[user] = None  # Явно помечаем как проблемного
    
    # ========== 4.1. ПОЛУЧАЕМ COST LEVELS ИЗ WORKER LEVEL ==========
    debug_log("STEP 4.1: Getting cost levels from Worker Level")
    
    cost_levels_cache = {}
    WorkerLevel = frappe.qb.DocType('Worker Level')
    
    for td in team_details:
        user = td.get('pt_participant')
        if user and user not in cost_levels_cache:
            worker_query = (
                frappe.qb.from_(Worker)
                .select(Worker.name)
                .where(Worker.wuser == user)
                .limit(1)
            )
            worker_result = worker_query.run(as_dict=True)
            
            if worker_result:
                worker_name = worker_result[0].get('name')
                wl_query = (
                    frappe.qb.from_(WorkerLevel)
                    .select(
                        WorkerLevel.wl_valid_from,
                        WorkerLevel.wl_cosl_level.as_('cost_level')
                    )
                    .where(WorkerLevel.parent == worker_name)
                    .orderby(WorkerLevel.wl_valid_from)
                )
                worker_levels = wl_query.run(as_dict=True)
                
                cost_levels_cache[user] = []
                for wl in worker_levels:
                    cost_levels_cache[user].append({
                        'valid_from': wl.get('wl_valid_from'),
                        'cost_level': wl.get('cost_level')
                    })
                debug_log(f"  User {user} cost levels: {len(cost_levels_cache[user])}")
            else:
                cost_levels_cache[user] = []
                debug_log(f"  User {user} has no Worker record")
    
    # ========== 5. ОПРЕДЕЛЯЕМ ИСТОЧНИК СТАВКИ ==========
    if payment_scheme == "Время и затраты (T&M)":
        rate_source_field = "pt_category"
        rate_parenttype = "Rate Category"
    else:
        rate_source_field = "pt_cost_level"
        rate_parenttype = "Cost Level"
    
    debug_log(f"  rate_source_field: {rate_source_field}, parenttype: {rate_parenttype}")
    
    # ========== 6. ЗАГРУЖАЕМ СТАВКИ ==========
    parent_values = set()
    for td in team_details:
        if rate_source_field == "pt_category":
            value = td.get("pt_category")
            if value:
                parent_values.add(value)  # ← ДОБАВИТЬ ЭТУ СТРОКУ!
        else:
            value = td.get("pt_cost_level")
            if not value:
                user = td.get('pt_participant')
                user_cost_levels = cost_levels_cache.get(user, [])
                for cl in user_cost_levels:
                    if cl.get('cost_level'):
                        parent_values.add(cl.get('cost_level'))
            else:
                parent_values.add(value)
        
    debug_log(f"  parent_values: {parent_values}")
    
    rates = {}
    if parent_values:
        debug_log("STEP 6: Loading rate records")
        RateTable = frappe.qb.DocType('Rate Table')
        rate_query = (
            frappe.qb.from_(RateTable)
            .select(
                RateTable.parent,
                RateTable.rt_valid_from,
                RateTable.rt_rate,
                RateTable.rt_currency
            )
            .where(RateTable.parenttype == rate_parenttype)
            .where(RateTable.parent.isin(list(parent_values)))
        )
        rate_records = rate_query.run(as_dict=True)
        
        debug_log(f"  rate_records found: {len(rate_records)}")
        
        for rate in rate_records:
            parent = rate.get('parent')
            if parent not in rates:
                rates[parent] = []
            rates[parent].append({
                'valid_from': rate.get('rt_valid_from'),
                'rate': float(rate.get('rt_rate') or 0),
                'currency': rate.get('rt_currency')
            })
        
        for parent in rates:
            rates[parent].sort(key=lambda x: x['valid_from'] if x['valid_from'] else frappe.utils.getdate("1900-01-01"))
        
        debug_log(f"  rates loaded for parents: {list(rates.keys())}")
    
    # ========== 7. ПОЛУЧАЕМ ИНФОРМАЦИЮ ОБ ИЗМЕРЕНИЯХ ==========
    debug_log("STEP 7: Getting accounting dimension filters for Task")
    
    AccountingDimensionFilter = frappe.qb.DocType('Accounting Dimension Filter')
    ApplicableOnAccount = frappe.qb.DocType('Applicable On Account')
    
    dim_query = (
        frappe.qb.from_(AccountingDimensionFilter)
        .left_join(ApplicableOnAccount)
        .on(ApplicableOnAccount.parent == AccountingDimensionFilter.name)
        .select(
            AccountingDimensionFilter.name,
            ApplicableOnAccount.applicable_on_account.as_('account')
        )
        .where(AccountingDimensionFilter.accounting_dimension == 'Task')
        .where(AccountingDimensionFilter.disabled == 0)
    )
    task_dimension_filters = dim_query.run(as_dict=True)
    
    accounts_with_task_dimension = set()
    for row in task_dimension_filters:
        if row.get('account'):
            accounts_with_task_dimension.add(row.get('account'))
    
    debug_log(f"  Accounts supporting Task dimension: {accounts_with_task_dimension}")
    
    # ========== 7.5. ФУНКЦИЯ ПЕРЕСЧЕТА ПРОГНОЗА ==========
    def recalculate_forecast_and_loads(forecast_hours, users_data):
        type3_users = []
        other_users = []
        
        for u in users_data:
            if u.get('workload_type') == 'В % от трудоемкости задачи':
                type3_users.append(u)
            else:
                other_users.append(u)
        
        total_type3_load = sum(u.get('original_hours', 0) for u in type3_users)
        total_other_load = sum(u.get('original_hours', 0) for u in other_users)
        
        if forecast_hours < total_type3_load:
            new_forecast = total_type3_load
        else:
            new_forecast = forecast_hours
        
        remaining_forecast = max(0, new_forecast - total_type3_load)
        
        new_loads = {}
        for u in type3_users:
            new_loads[u.get('user')] = u.get('original_hours', 0)
        
        if total_other_load > 0 and remaining_forecast > 0:
            for u in other_users:
                ratio = u.get('original_hours', 0) / total_other_load
                new_loads[u.get('user')] = remaining_forecast * ratio
        else:
            for u in other_users:
                new_loads[u.get('user')] = 0
        
        return new_forecast, new_loads
    
    # ========== 8. РАССЧИТЫВАЕМ СУММЫ И ЗАПИСЫВАЕМ В БЮДЖЕТ ==========
    debug_log("STEP 8: Calculating amounts and saving to budget")
    
    results = []
    updated_count = 0
    should_stop = False
    
    for task in selected_tasks:
        debug_log(f"STEP 8.1: Processing task: {task}")
        task_details = forecast_details.get(task, {})
        
        aggregated_by_account_for_task = {}
        
        for role, periods in task_details.items():
            debug_log(f"  Role: {role}")
            
            # Находим пользователя с этой ролью (только с валидным worker type)
            matching_users = []
            for (td_role, td_user), td in team_details_map.items():
                if td_role == role:
                    user_type = user_type_cache.get(td_user)
                    if user_type:
                        matching_users.append((td_user, td))
                    else:
                        debug_log(f"    Skipping user {td_user} - no valid worker type")
            
            if not matching_users:
                debug_log(f"    No valid users found for role {role}, skipping")
                continue
            
            for period_key, hours_data in periods.items():
                forecast_hours = hours_data.get('forecast_hours', 0)
                users_data = hours_data.get('users', {})
                
                debug_log(f"    Period: {period_key}, forecast={forecast_hours}, users={len(users_data)}")
                
                # Пропускаем только если нет прогноза
                if forecast_hours == 0:
                    continue
                
                # Вместо try-except:
                if not period_key or '-' not in period_key:
                    debug_log(f"      Invalid period_key format: {period_key}")
                    continue
                
                parts = period_key.split('-')
                if len(parts) != 2:
                    debug_log(f"      Invalid period_key format: {period_key}")
                    continue
                
                # Проверяем, что обе части - числа
                if not parts[0].isdigit() or not parts[1].isdigit():
                    debug_log(f"      Invalid year/month in period_key: {period_key}")
                    continue
                
                year = int(parts[0])
                month = int(parts[1])
                
                period_date = frappe.utils.getdate(f"{year}-{month:02d}-01")
                
                # Собираем пользователей для этого периода
                users_for_period = []
                users_forecast_data = {}
                for user_email, user_info in users_data.items():
                    users_forecast_data[user_email] = user_info
                
                for user, team_detail in matching_users:
                    # Определяем parent для ставки
                    if rate_source_field == "pt_category":
                        parent_value = team_detail.get("pt_category")
                    else:
                        parent_value = team_detail.get("pt_cost_level")
                        if not parent_value:
                            user_cost_levels = cost_levels_cache.get(user, [])
                            for cl in user_cost_levels:
                                valid_from = cl.get('valid_from')
                                if not valid_from or valid_from <= period_date:
                                    parent_value = cl.get('cost_level')
                                else:
                                    break
                            if parent_value:
                                debug_log(f"      Using base_cost_level from Worker Level: {parent_value}")
                    
                    if not parent_value:
                        debug_log(f"      No rate source for user {user}")
                        continue
                    
                    parent_rates = rates.get(parent_value, [])
                    if not parent_rates:
                        debug_log(f"      No rates found for parent={parent_value}")
                        continue
                    
                    applicable_rate = None
                    for rate_info in parent_rates:
                        valid_from = rate_info.get('valid_from')
                        if valid_from and valid_from <= period_date:
                            applicable_rate = rate_info
                        else:
                            break
                    
                    if not applicable_rate:
                        applicable_rate = parent_rates[-1] if parent_rates else None
                    
                    if not applicable_rate:
                        debug_log(f"      No applicable rate for user {user}")
                        continue
                    
                    user_type = user_type_cache.get(user, 'Employee')
                    
                    applicable_account = None
                    for at in account_table:
                        valid_from = at.get('ac_valid_from')
                        if at.get('ac_type') == user_type:
                            if not valid_from or valid_from <= period_date:
                                applicable_account = at.get('ac_account')
                                debug_log(f"      Found account: {applicable_account} (type={user_type})")
                                break
                    
                    if not applicable_account:
                        debug_log(f"      No account found for user_type={user_type}")
                        continue
                    
                    user_forecast_info = users_forecast_data.get(user, {})
                    workload_type = user_forecast_info.get('workload_type', 'В рабочих часах')
                    percentage = user_forecast_info.get('percentage', 0)
                    assigned = user_forecast_info.get('assigned_hours', 0)
                    
                    if workload_type == 'В % от трудоемкости задачи':
                        original_hours = forecast_hours
                    else:
                        original_hours = assigned
                    
                    debug_log(f"      User: {user}, type={workload_type}, hours={original_hours}")
                    
                    users_for_period.append({
                        'user': user,
                        'workload_type': workload_type,
                        'percentage': percentage,
                        'original_hours': original_hours,
                        'rate': applicable_rate.get('rate'),
                        'currency': applicable_rate.get('currency'),
                        'user_type': user_type,
                        'applicable_account': applicable_account,
                        'has_task_dimension': applicable_account in accounts_with_task_dimension,
                        'team_detail': team_detail
                    })
                
                # Проверка перегрузки
                total_pwa_hours = sum(u.get('original_hours', 0) for u in users_for_period)
                
                if total_pwa_hours > forecast_hours + 1:
                    debug_log(f"      *** OVERLOAD: PWA={total_pwa_hours} > PWE={forecast_hours} ***")
                    
                    if not confirm_recalc:
                        frappe.response["message"] = {
                            'success': False,
                            'needs_confirmation': True,
                            'message': f'Обнаружена перегрузка: назначенная загрузка ({round(total_pwa_hours, 2)}ч) превышает прогнозные трудозатраты ({forecast_hours}ч) по задаче "{task}", роли "{role}", периоду {period_key}. Выполнить пересчет прогноза на основании текущей загрузки?',
                            'task': task,
                            'role': role,
                            'period': period_key,
                            'forecast_hours': forecast_hours,
                            'total_pwa_hours': total_pwa_hours
                        }
                        should_stop = True
                        break
                    else:
                        debug_log(f"      User confirmed, recalculating...")
                        recalc_result = recalculate_forecast_and_loads(forecast_hours, users_for_period)
                        new_forecast = recalc_result[0]
                        new_loads = recalc_result[1]
                        
                        for u in users_for_period:
                            user_email = u.get('user')
                            if user_email in new_loads:
                                u['original_hours'] = new_loads[user_email]
                                debug_log(f"      Updated hours for {user_email}: {new_loads[user_email]}h")
                
                # Проверка недогрузки
                elif total_pwa_hours < forecast_hours - 1:
                    debug_log(f"      *** UNDERLOAD: PWA={total_pwa_hours} < PWE={forecast_hours} ***")
                    
                    virtual = virtual_team_map.get(role)
                    
                    if not virtual:
                        debug_log(f"      ERROR: No virtual worker for role {role}")
                        frappe.response["message"] = {
                            'success': False,
                            'error': f'Для роли "{role}" не найден виртуальный участник в команде проекта. Невозможно распределить остаток прогнозных часов ({round(forecast_hours - total_pwa_hours, 2)}ч).'
                        }
                        should_stop = True
                        break
                    
                    if not confirm_recalc:
                        frappe.response["message"] = {
                            'success': False,
                            'needs_confirmation': True,
                            'message': f'Обнаружена недогрузка: прогнозные трудозатраты ({forecast_hours}ч) превышают назначенную загрузку ({round(total_pwa_hours, 2)}ч) по задаче "{task}", роли "{role}", периоду {period_key}. Будет использован виртуальный участник для покрытия остатка ({round(forecast_hours - total_pwa_hours, 2)}ч). Продолжить?',
                            'task': task,
                            'role': role,
                            'period': period_key,
                            'forecast_hours': forecast_hours,
                            'total_pwa_hours': total_pwa_hours
                        }
                        should_stop = True
                        break
                    else:
                        debug_log(f"      User confirmed, adding virtual worker for role {role}")
                        
                        virtual_hours = forecast_hours - total_pwa_hours
                        
                        if rate_source_field == "pt_category":
                            parent_value = virtual.get("pt_category")
                        else:
                            parent_value = virtual.get("pt_cost_level")
                        
                        if not parent_value:
                            debug_log(f"      ERROR: No rate source for virtual worker role {role}")
                            frappe.response["message"] = {
                                'success': False,
                                'error': f'Для виртуального участника роли "{role}" не заполнена ставка.'
                            }
                            should_stop = True
                            break
                        
                        parent_rates = rates.get(parent_value, [])
                        if not parent_rates:
                            debug_log(f"      No rates found for parent={parent_value}")
                            continue
                        
                        applicable_rate = None
                        for rate_info in parent_rates:
                            valid_from = rate_info.get('valid_from')
                            if valid_from and valid_from <= period_date:
                                applicable_rate = rate_info
                            else:
                                break
                        
                        if not applicable_rate:
                            applicable_rate = parent_rates[-1] if parent_rates else None
                        
                        if not applicable_rate:
                            debug_log(f"      No applicable rate for virtual worker role {role}")
                            continue
                        
                        user_type = virtual.get("worker_type")
                        debug_log(f"      Virtual worker user_type: {user_type}")
                        
                        applicable_account = None
                        for at in account_table:
                            valid_from = at.get('ac_valid_from')
                            if at.get('ac_type') == user_type:
                                if not valid_from or valid_from <= period_date:
                                    applicable_account = at.get('ac_account')
                                    debug_log(f"      Found account for virtual worker: {applicable_account} (type={user_type})")
                                    break
                        
                        if not applicable_account:
                            debug_log(f"      No account found for user_type={user_type}")
                            continue
                        
                        users_for_period.append({
                            'user': f'VIRTUAL_{role}',
                            'workload_type': 'Виртуальный участник',
                            'percentage': 0,
                            'original_hours': virtual_hours,
                            'rate': applicable_rate.get('rate'),
                            'currency': applicable_rate.get('currency'),
                            'user_type': user_type,
                            'applicable_account': applicable_account,
                            'has_task_dimension': applicable_account in accounts_with_task_dimension,
                            'team_detail': virtual,
                            'is_virtual': True
                        })
                        
                        debug_log(f"      Added virtual worker for {role}: {virtual_hours}h at rate {applicable_rate.get('rate')} {applicable_rate.get('currency')}")
                
                # Агрегируем суммы по статьям
                for u in users_for_period:
                    amount = u.get('original_hours', 0) * u.get('rate', 0)
                    applicable_account = u.get('applicable_account')
                    has_task_dimension = u.get('has_task_dimension', False)
                    
                    debug_log(f"      User: {u.get('user')}, hours={u.get('original_hours')}, rate={u.get('rate')}, amount={amount}, account={applicable_account}")
                    
                    key = (applicable_account, year, month, has_task_dimension)
                    if key not in aggregated_by_account_for_task:
                        aggregated_by_account_for_task[key] = {
                            'total_amount': 0,
                            'users': [],
                            'has_task_dimension': has_task_dimension,
                            'account': applicable_account,
                            'year': year,
                            'month': month
                        }
                    aggregated_by_account_for_task[key]['total_amount'] = aggregated_by_account_for_task[key]['total_amount'] + amount
                    if u.get('user') not in aggregated_by_account_for_task[key]['users']:
                        aggregated_by_account_for_task[key]['users'].append(u.get('user'))
            
            if should_stop:
                break
        
        if should_stop:
            break
        
        # Записываем агрегированные суммы в бюджет
        for key, acc_data in aggregated_by_account_for_task.items():
            total_amount = acc_data['total_amount']
            
            if total_amount == 0:
                debug_log(f"      Skipping zero amount for account={acc_data['account']}, year={acc_data['year']}, month={acc_data['month']}")
                continue
            
            users_list = ', '.join(set(acc_data['users']))
            applicable_account = acc_data['account']
            year = acc_data['year']
            month = acc_data['month']
            has_task_dimension = acc_data['has_task_dimension']
            
            debug_log(f"      Writing to budget: account={applicable_account}, year={year}, month={month}, total_amount={total_amount}, users=[{users_list}]")
            
            # Ищем существующий Project Budget
            ProjectBudget = frappe.qb.DocType('Project Budget')
            ProjectBudgetDimension = frappe.qb.DocType('Project Budget Dimension')
            
            if has_task_dimension:
                pb_query = (
                    frappe.qb.from_(ProjectBudget)
                    .left_join(ProjectBudgetDimension)
                    .on(ProjectBudgetDimension.parent == ProjectBudget.name)
                    .select(ProjectBudget.name)
                    .where(ProjectBudget.pb_project == project)
                    .where(ProjectBudget.pb_account == applicable_account)
                    .where(ProjectBudgetDimension.doc == 'Task')
                    .where(ProjectBudgetDimension.docname == task)
                    .limit(1)
                )
                pb_result = pb_query.run(as_dict=True)
                pb_name = pb_result[0].get('name') if pb_result else None
            else:
                pb_query = (
                    frappe.qb.from_(ProjectBudget)
                    .select(ProjectBudget.name)
                    .where(ProjectBudget.pb_project == project)
                    .where(ProjectBudget.pb_account == applicable_account)
                    .limit(1)
                )
                pb_result = pb_query.run(as_dict=True)
                pb_name = pb_result[0].get('name') if pb_result else None
            
            if pb_name:
                doc = frappe.get_doc("Project Budget", pb_name)
                debug_log(f"      Found existing Project Budget: {pb_name}")
                
                if has_task_dimension:
                    task_dimension_exists = False
                    for dim in doc.project_budget_dimension:
                        if dim.doc == "Task" and dim.docname == task:
                            task_dimension_exists = True
                            break
                    
                    if not task_dimension_exists:
                        doc.append("project_budget_dimension", {
                            "doc": "Task",
                            "docname": task
                        })
                        debug_log(f"      Added missing Task dimension: {task}")
            else:
                doc = frappe.new_doc("Project Budget")
                doc.pb_project = project
                doc.pb_account = applicable_account
                
                if has_task_dimension:
                    doc.append("project_budget_dimension", {
                        "doc": "Task",
                        "docname": task
                    })
                    debug_log(f"      Added Task dimension: {task}")
                
                doc.insert()
                debug_log(f"      Created new Project Budget: {doc.name}")
            
            # Обновляем прогноз для периода
            amount_exists = False
            for amount_row in doc.project_budget_amount:
                if int(amount_row.pba_year) == int(year) and int(amount_row.pba_month) == int(month):
                    old_value = amount_row.pba_expected
                    amount_row.pba_expected = total_amount
                    amount_exists = True
                    debug_log(f"      >>> UPDATED amount for {year}-{month}: {old_value} -> {total_amount}")
                    break
            
            if not amount_exists:
                doc.append("project_budget_amount", {
                    "pba_year": year,
                    "pba_month": month,
                    "pba_expected": total_amount
                })
                debug_log(f"      Added NEW amount for {year}-{month}: {total_amount}")
            
            doc.save()
            updated_count += 1
            debug_log(f"      Saved Project Budget: {doc.name}")
            
            results.append({
                'task': task,
                'year': year,
                'month': month,
                'total_amount': total_amount,
                'account': applicable_account,
                'users': users_list
            })
    
    if should_stop:
        debug_log("STEP 9: Stopped due to confirmation request")
    else:
        debug_log("STEP 9: Calculations completed")
        debug_log(f"  Total results: {len(results)}")
        debug_log(f"  Budget records updated: {updated_count}")
        
        log(f"Forecast added: {updated_count} budget records updated")
        
        frappe.response["message"] = {
            'success': True,
            'message': f'Рассчитано {len(results)} сумм. Обновлено {updated_count} записей в бюджете.',
            'results': results,
            'updated_count': updated_count
        }

debug_log("_________________ Script completed _________________")

script:
# Тикет -- https://erp.dinord.ru/app/issue/ISS-2025-00064
def get_project_budget_name(project, account, dimensions=None):
    """
    Находит name документа "Project Budget" по (project, account) и точному совпадению
    набора записей в дочерней таблице "Project Budget Dimension".

    dimensions: list of dicts, each dict содержит keys 'doc' и 'docname', например:
        [{"doc": "Cost Center", "docname": "CC-001"},
         {"doc": "Department",  "docname": "DPT-02"}]

    Возвращает name (str) найденного Project Budget или None.
    """
    # нормализуем вход
    if dimensions:
        dims = list(dimensions)
    else:
        dims = []

    # Случай: dimensions пустой => ищем бюджеты, у которых НЕТ записей в child table
    if not dims:
        sql = """
            SELECT pb.name
            FROM `tabProject Budget` pb
            LEFT JOIN `tabProject Budget Dimension` pbd
              ON pbd.parent = pb.name
            WHERE pb.pb_project = %s
              AND pb.pb_account = %s
            GROUP BY pb.name
            HAVING COUNT(pbd.name) = 0
            LIMIT 1
        """
        res = frappe.db.sql(sql, (project, account))
        return (res[0][0] if res else None)

    # Случай: dimensions заданы => точное совпадение набора записей
    # Построим условие вида:
    # HAVING COUNT(*) = n
    #    AND SUM(CASE WHEN (pbd.doc = d1 AND pbd.docname = n1) AND (pbd.doc = d2 AND pbd.docname = n2) ... THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = n
    n = len(dims)
    dim_parts = []
    params = [project, account, n]

    for dim in dims:
        # предполагается, что dim имеет ключи 'doc' и 'docname'
        # если это не так — адаптируй имена полей здесь
        dim_parts.append("(pbd.doc = %s AND pbd.docname = %s)")
        params.extend([dim["doc"], dim["docname"]])

    dim_clause = " OR ".join(dim_parts)

    sql = f"""
        SELECT pb.name
        FROM `tabProject Budget` pb
        JOIN `tabProject Budget Dimension` pbd
          ON pbd.parent = pb.name
        WHERE pb.pb_project = %s
          AND pb.pb_account = %s
        GROUP BY pb.name
        HAVING COUNT(*) = %s
           AND SUM(CASE WHEN ({dim_clause}) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = %s
        LIMIT 1
    """
    params.append(n)   # для SUM(...) = %s
    
    log("SQL: " + frappe.utils.cstr(sql))
    log("SQL Params: " + frappe.utils.cstr(params))
    res = frappe.db.sql(sql, tuple(params))
    log("SQL result: " + frappe.utils.cstr(res))
    return (res[0][0] if res else None)

log("---------- Сохранение плановых данных бюджета проекта ----------")

# --Сохранение плановых данных--
project = frappe.form_dict.get("project")
data = frappe.form_dict.get("data", "[]")

log(f"Начало обработки: project={project}")

# Проверка "на глаз" перед парсингом (ненадежно!)
if not data or not data.strip() or not data.strip().startswith('[') or not data.strip().endswith(']'):
    #log("Неверный формат JSON данных")
    frappe.throw("Неверный формат данных")
else:
    data_list = json.loads(data)  # Все равно может упасть с исключением!
    #log(f"Начало обработки: data_list={frappe.utils.cstr( data_list )}")


processed_count = 0

for item in data_list:
    # Получаем значения с проверкой на None
    account = item.get("account") or ""
    dimensions = item.get("dimensions") or []
    amounts = item.get("amounts") or []
    
    log("Обработка: account=" + frappe.utils.cstr(account) + ", dimensions=" + frappe.utils.cstr(dimensions) + 
        ", amounts=" + frappe.utils.cstr(amounts) )
    
    # Проверяем обязательные поля
    if not account or not amounts:
        log("Пропуск - пустые данные")
        continue
        
    # Получаем или создаем документ Project Budget
    pb_name = get_project_budget_name(project, account, dimensions)

    if pb_name:
        pb_doc = frappe.get_doc("Project Budget", pb_name)
        log("Найден Project Budge: " + frappe.utils.cstr(pb_doc.name))
    else:
        log("Создаем новую запись Project Budge")
        pb_doc = frappe.new_doc("Project Budget")
        pb_doc.pb_project = project
        pb_doc.pb_account = account
        
        if dimensions:
            pb_doc.append("project_budget_dimension", dimensions)
            
        pb_doc.insert()
        log("Создан новый Project Budge: " + frappe.utils.cstr(pb_doc.name))
    
    for amount in amounts:
        # Ищем существующую запись для этого периода
        # Преобразуем типы
        year = int(amount.get("year"))
        month = int(amount.get("month"))
        plan_value = float(amount.get("plan_value"))
        
        existing_row = None
        for row in pb_doc.project_budget_amount:
            if int(row.pba_year) == year and int(row.pba_month) == month:
                existing_row = row
                break
        
        if existing_row:
            log("Обновление строки: старый план=" + frappe.utils.cstr(existing_row.pba_plan) + 
                ", новый план=" + frappe.utils.cstr(plan_value))
            existing_row.pba_plan = plan_value
        else:
            log("Создание новой строки периода: year=" + frappe.utils.cstr(year) + 
                ", month=" + frappe.utils.cstr(month) + ", plan=" + frappe.utils.cstr(plan_value))
            new_row = {
                "pba_year": year,
                "pba_month": month,
                "pba_plan": plan_value,
                "pba_expected": 0
            }
            pb_doc.append("project_budget_amount", new_row)
    
    pb_doc.save()
    log("Документ сохранен: " + frappe.utils.cstr(pb_doc.name))
    processed_count = processed_count + 1

log("Обработка завершена. Обработано записей: " + frappe.utils.cstr(processed_count))
